landing.heroText: No more half an hour of scrolling. Personal tips for films and series, only from what's on your streaming services. For watching together with your partner, too.
landing.screenshotForYou: Personal tips with a match percentage in Kijkassistent
landing.step1Text: You only get tips for what you can actually watch.
landing.step2Text: Choose a few favourite films and series. The more you tell us, the better the tips.
landing.step3Text: Personal tips with a match percentage and where to watch them.
landing.togetherTitle: No more arguing about what to watch.
landing.togetherText: Link your partner and Kijkassistent finds what suits you both.
landing.together2: A tip for tonight, every night: thrilling, funny or relaxing
landing.together3: A shared watchlist and your taste match
landing.screenshotTogether: Tonight's tip for the two of you
landing.faq1A: Nothing. Kijkassistent is free and has no ads.
landing.faq2A: We only use your ratings for your own tips. No ads, no tracking, and you can delete your account yourself whenever you like.
landing.faq3Q: Does it work on my phone?
landing.faq3A: Yes, right in your browser. You can also add the app to your home screen.
landing.closingText: Create a free account and get your first tips within a few minutes.

genreWarning.title: Is this right? Your favourites fall into genres you've excluded
genreWarning.text: Excluded genres are never recommended, not even if a favourite resembles them. That makes your recommendations very narrow. Only tick what you really don't want to see.

wizard.s1Text: Choose your streaming services. Don't have any? Then choose “Skip this step”.
wizard.s2Text: Choose at least {min} films and series you really love. These choices count heavily in your film and series recommendations.
wizard.s3Text: Select the genres you really don't like, so they're left out of your recommendations.
wizard.s3Warning: This is a list of what you don't want to see. A genre you tap disappears completely from your recommendations, even if one of your favourites falls into it. Happy with everything? Then don't tap anything and continue.
wizard.excluded: {count, plural, one {# genre} other {# genres}} excluded: these will no longer appear in your recommendations.
wizard.s4Text: Optional — films and series featuring them rank higher in your recommendations.
wizard.s5Text: A few handy things to know.
wizard.tipForYou: Three tabs — from “Just my taste” to “Surprise me” — each with different recommendations. Rate what you see; the more you rate, the sharper it gets.
wizard.tipSearch: Here you can always add more favourites or rate something straight away — without marking it as a favourite.
wizard.tipSettings: You can always change your streaming services, excluded genres and favourite actors/directors here.
wizard.tipLetterboxd: On a PC or laptop you can import your films and ratings from Letterboxd in Settings. Then Kijkassistent doesn't start from zero.
wizard.tipTogether: Link your partner (also in Settings) to see recommendations you'd both enjoy.

deletePage.heading: Delete account and data
deletePage.sub: For users of Kijkassistent (app and website).
deletePage.selfTitle: Delete it yourself in the app
deletePage.self2: Open Settings (on the right of the bottom bar).
deletePage.selfNote: Your account and everything that leads back to you will be erased immediately and permanently. This cannot be undone. We only keep what you thought of films and series, anonymously (see below).
deletePage.removed1: Your account, with your email address and login details.
deletePage.removed2: Your favourite films, series, actors and directors.
deletePage.removed4: Your settings, such as streaming services and excluded genres.
deletePage.removed5: Any link with a partner and the shared list and ratings.
deletePage.removed6: Stored recommendations that were calculated for you.
deletePage.anonText: To make recommendations better for everyone, before erasing we keep an anonymous copy of your taste: which films and series you rated, had as favourites, had on your watchlist or hid, your verdicts in "Together", your favourite actors and directors, your streaming services and your preferences. This is stored under a random code, without email address, account or partner, and with only the month instead of the exact date. After that it can no longer be traced back to you, not even by us.
deletePage.noLoginText: Then send an email to <mail></mail>, from the email address you signed up with, and ask for deletion. We'll delete your account and data within 30 days and let you know when it's done.
deletePage.moreText: Read in our <link>privacy statement</link> which data we keep and why.
